title: No more UAM ??
symptom: User reports that no UAM (unannounced meal) bars appear on the graphs for several weeks, despite having IOB greater than 2x basal rate and UAM enabled in settings. Multiple users confirm the issue persists on dev and master versions.
cause: The thread identifies that using AAPS sensitivity (instead of Oref1 sensitivity) disables UAM detection. The user states: 'If you use AAPS sensibility, you loose UAM. Using Oref1 sensitivity brings back the UAM.'
fix: Switch sensitivity plugin from AAPS to Oref1 sensitivity. The user reports that setting Oref1 sensitivity restores UAM bars.
evidence_quote: Issue probably solved. If you use _AAPS sensibility_, you loose UAM. Using Oref1 sensitivity brings back the UAM.
